# Owned media fixtures

Generated solely for pi-a2ui tests: blue32x32PNG, one-second440Hz PCM16 mono16kHzWAV, and1.2-second blue VP8WebM(Chromium MediaRecorder). No external media or licences. The local ffmpeg binary failed to load x265 during generation; Pythonstdlib(PNG/WAV) and the existing Chromium1248 recorder produced these instead. No generator is a runtime dependency. Real Chromium decoding/playback is the consumer oracle; header classification alone is not decoding evidence.
